page.welcome.title: Welcome to Aelum
page.welcome.subtitle: This installer will guide you through setting up your system.
page.userAccount.title: Create user account
page.userAccount.subtitle: Choose a username and secure password for your system.
page.userAccount.usernameHint: Username: 3+ characters, letters and numbers only
page.diskSelection.title: Select Installation Disk
page.diskSelection.subtitle: Choose a disk and filesystem to install Aelum.
page.diskSelection.selectDiskFirst: Select a disk before switching to manual mode.
page.diskSelection.selectDiskManual: Select a disk, then switch to manual mode to design your own partition layout.
manual.dualbootHint: Only your chosen Boot and Root partitions are touched — everything else is left as-is.
manual.noPartitions: No partitions on this disk yet.
manual.hint: Designate one partition as Boot (ESP) and one as Root (System). Leave the rest as Preserve to keep your other OS and data safe. New partitions start blank — add one, then set its type below.
manual.addHint: Add new partition, then set its type.
manual.addTooSmall: Partition size must be at least 1 MB.
manual.deleteMessage: This removes the partition from your install plan and frees its space for other partitions. The partition stays on your disk until you run the install — cancel before then and nothing changes.
manual.assignHint: Tip: assign Boot first, then Root. Mountpoints are assigned automatically — you never set them.
validation.selectDiskManual: Designate one partition as Boot and one as Root to continue.
page.confirmation.title: Installation Summary
page.confirmation.subtitle: Review your installation settings before proceeding.
page.installation.title: Installing Aelum
page.finish.title: Installation Complete
dialog.confirm.title: Confirm Installation
dialog.confirm.message: Are you sure you want to install Aelum on {model}? All data on this disk will be permanently erased.

validation.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 6 characters
validation.selectLanguage: Please select a language to continue.
validation.selectUserAccount: Please complete all required fields to continue.
validation.selectDisk: Please select a disk to continue.
